UDP echo server command that builds topology, sets ports, and starts the process.

# Purpose
This file defines the `udpecho` command for `fdctl`. It builds a topology for a UDP echo service, sets tile CPU affinity, creates the required workspaces and tiles, and then starts the runtime. The main topology setup is done in [`udpecho_topo`](<#udpecho_topo>), which resets `config->topo`, adds the `metric`, `l4swap`, and network tiles, connects them with links, and applies either fixed or automatic CPU layout. It also prints the final topology log after the layout is complete.

The command interface is defined by [`udpecho_cmd_args`](<#udpecho_cmd_args>) and [`udpecho_cmd_fn`](<#udpecho_cmd_fn>). [`udpecho_cmd_args`](<#udpecho_cmd_args>) reads the `--port` or `-p` option and stores the listen port in `args->udpecho.listen_port`. [`udpecho_cmd_fn`](<#udpecho_cmd_fn>) applies that port to the `net` tile, sets the Prometheus listen address and port for the `metric` tile, runs the required configuration stages, prepares workspaces and network namespaces, installs XDP, joins shared memory, and starts the topology in a single process. The file ends with the `fd_action_udpecho` action record, which exposes the command name, argument parser, handler, and description to the command framework.
